eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Sex assigned at birth and contraceptive/barrier requirements
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: See the IIBD master protocol for details, including AMAB and AFAB participation in the study, including IOCBP and INOCBP, and contraception criteria for mirikizumab. See Section 10.4 of this ISA for the contraception criteria for LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: GLP-1 RA stable dose
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants taking GLP-1 RAs, GLP-1/GIP RAs, GLP-1/Gcg RAs, GLP-1/GIP/Gcg RAs, or similar medications for approved indications will be permitted to enroll provided they are on a stable dose at the time of screening (no anticipated dose escalations).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Renal impairment exclusion
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have an eGFR <90 mL/min/1.73 m2 determined by the central laboratory during screening (Visit 1).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Hepatic disease or impairment exclusion
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a hepatic disease or hepatic impairment, defined as any of the following: cirrhosis, primary biliary cholangitis, viral hepatitis, autoimmune hepatitis, or signs or symptoms of any other liver disease (exception: metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease [MASLD]); any degree of hepatic impairment as defined by the Child-Pugh classification (Child-Pugh A, B, or C), regardless of etiology.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Osteoporosis or vitamin D deficiency exclusion
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a history of osteoporosis, osteomalacia, or presence of untreated severe vitamin D deficiency (serum 25-hydroxy-vitamin D ≤5 ng/mL).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Fracture or bone surgery exclusion
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a history of fracture, bone surgery (for example, hardware placement, join replacement, bone grafting, or amputation), or clinically significant bone trauma within 8 weeks of screening.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Addison disease exclusion
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a history of Addison disease.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Paget's disease exclusion
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a history of Paget's disease of the bone.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Other bone disease exclusion
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a history of any other bone disease that effects bone metabolism (for example, osteopetrosis or osteogenesis imperfecta).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Recent cardiovascular event exclusion
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have had within the past 180 days before screening: acute myocardial infarction; cerebrovascular accident (stroke); hospitalization for unstable angina; hospitalization due to congestive heart failure; or coronary revascularization.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Chronic neutropenia exclusion
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have a history of chronic neutropenia.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers exclusion
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have been treated with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers within 14 days or 5 half-lives (whichever is longer) prior to randomization, or plan to receive treatment with these CYP3A4 modulators during the study. See Section 10.14 for a list of moderate and strong CYP3A4 inhibitors and inducers.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: CYP3A4 narrow therapeutic index substrates exclusion
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have been treated with CYP3A4 substrates with a narrow therapeutic index within 14 days or 5 half-lives (whichever is longer) prior to randomization, or plan to receive treatment with these CYP3A4 modulators during the study. See Section 10.14 for a list of CYP3A4 substrates with a narrow therapeutic index.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Bone active treatments exclusion
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Have received any of the following bone active treatments within the time frames specified below, or plan to receive them during the study: oral bisphosphonate use (>3 months cumulative treatment in the past 2 years, OR >1 month in the past year, OR any use during the 3 months prior to screening); administration of intravenous zoledronic acid within the last 5 years; administration of intravenous bisphosphonate (excluding zoledronic acid), fluoride, or strontium within the past 2 years; parathyroid hormone (PTH), or PTH derivative (teriparatide, abaloparatide) in the past year; or treatment with denosumab in the past year.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Treatments within 3 months of screening exclusion
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Administration of any of the following treatments within 3 months of screening.

arms.name: LY4395089/Mirikizumab Co-administration
arms.description: Participants receive LY4395089 6 mg QD orally co-administered with mirikizumab IV in Study Period 1. Responders at Week 12 transition to mirikizumab SC monotherapy in Study Period 2.

arms.name: Mirikizumab
arms.description: Participants receive mirikizumab IV per approved product labeling in Study Period 1. Responders at Week 12 transition to mirikizumab SC monotherapy in Study Period 2.

objectives.name: Primary Objective
objectives.text: To assess the potential efficacy of LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab in adults with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease

endpoints.name: Primary Efficacy Endpoint
endpoints.text: Endoscopic response or clinical response (by CDAI) at Week 12 of Study Period 1, as defined in the IIBD master protocol

objectives.name: Secondary Safety and Tolerability Objective
objectives.text: To assess the safety of LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab in adults with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease

endpoints.name: Adverse Events Endpoint
endpoints.text: Incidence and severity of adverse events (AEs), including adverse events of special interest (AESIs), from baseline through safety follow-up

endpoints.name: Clinical Laboratory Tests Endpoint
endpoints.text: Change from baseline in clinical safety laboratory tests (hematology, clinical chemistry, coagulation, urinalysis, lipids) through end of study

endpoints.name: Electrocardiogram Endpoint
endpoints.text: Change from baseline in 12-lead ECG parameters through end of study

endpoints.name: CDAI Clinical Response Endpoint
endpoints.text: Clinical response as measured by Crohn's Disease Activity Index (CDAI) at Week 12 of Study Period 1

endpoints.name: Fecal Calprotectin Endpoint
endpoints.text: Change from baseline in fecal calprotectin at Week 12 of Study Period 1

objectives.name: Secondary Efficacy Objective
objectives.text: To assess additional efficacy measures of LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab in adults with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease

endpoints.name: Serious Adverse Events Endpoint
endpoints.text: Incidence and severity of serious adverse events (SAEs) from baseline through safety follow-up

endpoints.name: Vital Signs Endpoint
endpoints.text: Change from baseline in vital signs (pulse rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and body temperature) through end of study

endpoints.name: Bone Mineral Density Endpoint
endpoints.text: Change from baseline in bone mineral density as assessed by dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA scan) at Week 12 of Study Period 1

endpoints.name: Endoscopic Response Endpoint
endpoints.text: Endoscopic response as assessed by Simple Endoscopic Score for Crohn's Disease (SES-CD) at Week 12 of Study Period 1

endpoints.name: hsCRP Endpoint
endpoints.text: Change from baseline in high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP) at Week 12 of Study Period 1

objectives.name: Exploratory Pharmacokinetic Objective
objectives.text: To characterize the pharmacokinetics of LY4395089 when co-administered with mirikizumab in adults with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease

endpoints.name: LY4395089 Predose PK Endpoint
endpoints.text: Predose steady-state plasma concentration of LY4395089 collected at Visit 4 (Week 4) in the LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration treatment group

endpoints.name: Bone Turnover Markers Endpoint
endpoints.text: Change from baseline in bone turnover markers (P1NP, CTX-1, bone-specific ALP) through Week 12 of Study Period 1

endpoints.name: Exploratory Stool Supernatant Biomarker Endpoint
endpoints.text: Exploratory biomarkers measured from stool supernatant samples collected at baseline and through Week 12 of Study Period 1

objectives.name: Exploratory Pharmacodynamic Objective
objectives.text: To characterize the pharmacodynamic effects of LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab in adults with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease

endpoints.name: LY4395089 Postdose PK Endpoint
endpoints.text: Postdose plasma concentration of LY4395089 collected as close as possible to 4 hours post LY4395089 administration at Visit 5 (Week 8) in the LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration treatment group

endpoints.name: Vitamin D Pharmacodynamic Endpoint
endpoints.text: Change from baseline in serum 25-hydroxy vitamin D levels through Week 12 of Study Period 1

endpoints.name: Exploratory Colonic Tissue Biomarker Endpoint
endpoints.text: Exploratory biomarkers measured from colonic tissue obtained from endoscopic biopsy at screening and Week 12 of Study Period 1

objectives.name: Exploratory Biomarker Objective
objectives.text: To explore biomarkers associated with response to LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab in adults with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease

endpoints.name: FGF19 Pharmacodynamic Endpoint
endpoints.text: Change from baseline in FGF19 levels through Week 12 of Study Period 1

endpoints.name: Parathyroid Hormone Pharmacodynamic Endpoint
endpoints.text: Change from baseline in parathyroid hormone (PTH) levels through Week 12 of Study Period 1

endpoints.name: Immunogenicity Endpoint
endpoints.text: Incidence of anti_drug antibodies (ADA) to LY4395089 and mirikizumab through end of study

objectives.name: Exploratory Immunogenicity Objective
objectives.text: To evaluate the immunogenicity of LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab in adults with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease

endpoints.name: 7alphaC4 Bile Acid Pharmacodynamic Endpoint
endpoints.text: Change from baseline in 7alphaC4 bile acid levels through Week 12 of Study Period 1

endpoints.name: Exploratory Blood Biomarker Endpoint
endpoints.text: Exploratory biomarkers measured from blood samples collected at baseline and through Week 12 of Study Period 1

For details about the transition of participants from Study Period 1 to Study Period 2, see the schema (Section 1.2) and the relevant notes in the SoA for Study Period 2 (Section 1.3.2).
DXA scan must be completed at or within 7 days after V2. If rescan is needed and performed outside the 7 days, this will not be a protocol deviation.
AE collection should occur prior to the collection of the C-SSRS. Adapted for the assessment of ideation and behavior categories only.

The daily eDiary will be applicable only to Study Period 1 and ED, if ED occurs in Study Period 1. The daily eDiary for CD includes the following assessments: CDAI Stool Frequency, CDAI Abdominal Pain, CDAI General Well-Being, Bowel Movement Count.

Site personnel must ensure the participant is trained on daily eDiary completion before the endoscopy visits. Provide additional training as needed. For eDiary compliance requirements, see Section 8.1.2.1 of the IIBD master protocol.
Site personnel must fully explain and confirm participant understanding of questionnaire before the device is provided to collect response.
Participant eDiaries are to be completed daily by the participant at home and reviewed by study personnel. See Section 8.1.2.4 of the IIBD master protocol for more details about the eDiary.
At baseline, collect diary from participants who were not eligible for randomization (screen failed).

For IOCBP, negative test required prior to dosing at marked visits. In Study Period 1, urine pregnancy tests will be done on site only. Additional pregnancy tests (urine or serum) should be performed at any time during the study if a menstrual period is missed, or there is clinical suspicion of pregnancy, or as required by local law or regulation.
Optional; perform as needed to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals AFAB. See Sections 8.2.6 and 10.4.1 of the IIBD master protocol.

If HCV Ab test is positive, perform HCV RNA test (Section 8.2.9 of the IIBD master protocol).

Participants who had a TST will return 48 to 72 hours after placement to have their test results read. PPD test does not need to be read at the site but must be read by a trained medical professional, and the result must be presented to the site personnel prior to participant's randomization (Section 10.7 of the IIBD master protocol).
Collect clinical and laboratory components of CDAI (Section 8.1.2.1 of the IIBD master protocol) and assess participant eligibility at screening before colonoscopy and bowel preparation.
For details about the transition of participants from Study Period 1 to Study Period 2, see the schema (Section 1.2).

Participants who received LY/mirikizumab co-administration or mirikizumab in Study Period 1 and who are considered responders at Week 12 of Study Period 1 will receive mirikizumab SC starting at Week 0 of Study Period 2. For definition of responders, see Sections 4.1 and 8.1 of the IIBD master protocol.

For responders to mirikizumab or LY/mirikizumab co-administration treatment, Visit 6 and Visit 7 will occur on the same day and the Visit 6 procedures are not repeated at Visit 7 (excluding 'Register visit with IWRS').
Visit 8 and Visit 10 of the IIBD master protocol SoA do not apply to this ISA.
V7 will be conducted on same day as V6.

Perform as shown in this schedule and as needed at any visit based on participant status and standard of care. Includes examination of eyes, throat, heart, lungs, abdomen, and visual examination of the skin. May be performed by qualified personnel per local regulations. Assess for TB risk factors and for signs and symptoms of active TB, including an assessment of peripheral lymph nodes.

For IOCBP, negative test required prior to dosing at marked visits. In Study Period 2, urine pregnancy tests can be done on-site or at home. Additional pregnancy tests (urine or serum) should be performed at any time during the study if a menstrual period is missed, or there is clinical suspicion of pregnancy or as required by local law or regulation.
Optional per investigator's discretion; perform as needed to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals AFAB. See Section 8.2.6 and 10.4.1 of the IIBD master protocol.

Additional C. difficile testing is allowed throughout the study at the investigator's discretion.
